evals.name: registration-to-listing
evals.prompt: The librarian wants to register Aster and see Aster in the authors list. Plan the journey before writing code, tracing where the row gets its values.
evals.expected_output: A causal story with two typed slices, field origins, an acceptance example and a next step.
assertions: Places the request and past-tense fact in the owning swimlane and connects them to the visible result.
Identifies registration as a state change and the list as a state view.
Traces row identity to the author event source and name to the event payload.
Gives a concrete Given/When/Then and the next specialist skill.

evals.name: directory-to-welcome
evals.prompt: The outside directory reports a new author and the Library follows up with a welcome request. Design the slices and how we know each works.
evals.expected_output: An inbound translation and a local automation with a deliberate join.
assertions: Distinguishes outside and owning Library responsibilities.
Joins translation to automation at the private local fact.
Separates first and repeat observations from the reaction's addressed effect and redelivery.
Routes the reader to different skills for the crossing and local follow-up.

evals.name: accepted-code-first-change
evals.prompt: Our code-first Library has an agreed registration change; what do we do before calling the slice delivered? Don't add a modeling toolchain.
evals.expected_output: Reenter at the changed behavior and carry acceptance through implementation and delivery.
assertions: Keeps code-first work code-first and avoids restarting settled discovery.
Carries concrete examples to the command's addressed append or refusal and separately to the query result.
Checks the visible result against the running slice rather than relying on a build or an in-process test.
